title: Earnings Integrity — Pay for Orders Verified as Not Delivered on Cartwise Shopper Batches, with the Not-Delivered Reversal Tool
content:
An order that a wrong-address violation recorded against a completed batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches shows was handed to the wrong address was not delivered, and the pay the batch received for delivering it is taken back by the desk with one reversal against the batch's mileage posting on the verified not-delivered ground, within the clawback window and at most once for that posting.

## The recovery at a glance

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| What shows an order was not delivered | A wrong-address violation recorded against the completed batch on the shopper's contractor account |
| Who takes the pay back | The desk |
| Entry reversed | The batch's mileage posting |
| Ground | Order not delivered (verified) |
| When | Within the batch type's clawback window counted from completion |
| How often | At most once for that posting |

A batch against which no wrong-address violation is recorded has nothing taken back on this ground.

## Situation of use and capability of `reverse_undelivered_pay_ec14645c`

`reverse_undelivered_pay_ec14645c` takes back pay a shopper batch received for an order that was verified as not delivered. One call books a single pay reversal on the named batch against the one pay entry it names, with the ground order not delivered (verified) and today's date, and lowers the batch's earnings by the amount taken back; the reversal appears at once among the batch's earnings entries and in the shopper's pay breakdown.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reverse_undelivered_pay_ec14645c` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `batch_id` | The batch number of the shopper batch the reversal is booked on, as returned by the batch lookup for the verified shopper | Id |
| `source_event_id` | The reference number of the pay entry the amount is taken back from, as returned by the batch earnings-entry lookup for that batch | Id |
| `amount_usd` | The amount taken back, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent by the caller; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

The ground is not a parameter: every reversal this tool books carries the order-not-delivered (verified) ground.

## Return

A text receipt of a dictionary carrying `batch_event_id` (the reference number of the reversal entry), `batch_id`, `source_event_id` (the pay entry taken back from), `reversal_reason` (always `order_not_delivered_verified`), `amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `batch_earnings_usd` (the batch's earnings once the reversal is booked). Receiving the `batch_event_id` means the reversal is booked.
